## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] New endpoints appear in `/openapi.json` and `/api/v1/discover`
- [ ] New error states carry a `hint`; new self-checks carry a `remedy`
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] Any new migration is a new file, not an edit to an applied one
